evidence: cross-review of the Dependabot shadow step; the new tests "the shadow step writes nothing when the live head is not the event head", "the shadow step writes nothing when the head moves during the evaluation", "checkS1 compares version numbers exactly, with no size limit" and "the shadow step removes its own comment when an earlier one exists for this head" in test/pr-triage.test.mjs
